definitions.trunk_tilt_angle_deg: Angle of Hip-to-Shoulder vector relative to vertical upwards line (0 deg is perfectly upright).
definitions.ear_shoulder_hip_alignment_deg: Interior angle formed by Ear -> Shoulder -> Hip (180 deg is a completely straight upper posture).
definitions.elbow_angle_deg: Interior joint angle Shoulder -> Elbow -> Wrist.
definitions.left_hand_navel_dist_ratio: Euclidean distance between left wrist and navel normalized by torso length (mid-hip to mid-shoulder).
